messages:
maria: FYI we're greenlit for the customer's dedicated pool this Friday 22:00 UTC. Need a short sync: final quota headroom, autoscale hysteresis, customer load scripts, and post-run feedback capture. Quick ack + owners?

tom: I'll take quota + infra. Reserved 8 shards initially with headroom for 4 surge shards. Need to confirm subnet egress rules for their monitoring IPs.

julia: I'll handle the customer-facing checklist and confirm the contact list. Putting a 30m preflight call on the calendar Fri 21:15 UTC.

adarsh: SRE check. Suggested autoscale hysteresis: target_util 65%, scale_up_threshold 80%, scale_down_threshold 40%, cooldown_up 45s, cooldown_down 180s. Suggest phased canary: 5% -> 20% -> full over 20m if metrics stable.

lee: ML priming done with their 500k prompt corpus. Observed token distribution skewed to short responses (2-6 tokens) and occasional long tails. KV priming saved ~18% p99 latency in internal test. We'll keep an eye on quality drift — baseline eval run attached.

sam: CS/enablement - I'll host the preflight call and collect the customer's warmup script. They said they can run our curl smoke but will prefer k6 for the soak. Will ask them to tag runs with header X-Run-ID.

tom: ops loadscript (k6) snippet we provided to them: 
```bash
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  let res = http.post('https://dedicated.blueprint.redwood/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model: 'blueprint-v2', input: 'test prompt'}), { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${__ENV.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Run-ID': 'customer-123' } });
  check(res, { 'status 200': (r) => r.status === 200, 'lat < 2s': (r) => r.timings.duration < 2000 });
}
```
We will run a short 10m ramp then 40m soak from two regions.

adarsh: Rollback triggers: error-rate > 2% for >3m OR p95 latency > 2.5s sustained for >5m. If trigger, route traffic to hosted fallback and scale pool to min. Revert script: `ops/revert_to_hosted --pool blueprint-123`.

lee: Smoke curl (customer-friendly) to share on call: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST 'https://dedicated.blueprint.redwood/v1/generate' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"blueprint-v2","input":"Hello, please summarize this."}' | jq '.'
```
Note: they must use their dedicated endpoint URL.

maria: deploy-bot scheduled window: 2024-05-17T22:00:00Z - 2024-05-17T23:45:00Z. Canary policy set to 5% for 5m, then 20% for 15m, then 100% if metrics fine. Hooks: latency, error-rate, tokens/sec, cpu/gpu util.

julia: Post-run I will send a feedback form and a short enablement checklist (how to interpret metrics + who to ping). Also logging the customer's request for longer retention on traces (we'll follow up with privacy/compliance).

tom: small note: billing needs final commit approval before we flip full traffic. Maria, can you confirm signed PO?

maria: PO is signed, finance confirmed. 

sam: On the preflight call I'll ask customer to run a 5m smoke using our curl and share the run-id. We'll validate headers and logs. I'll post run-ids to this thread.

adarsh: Loadtest acceptance criteria: 
- error-rate < 1% over 10m window
- p95 latency < 1.8s
- no dropped connections observed in monitor logs
If all pass, we follow canary ramp.

deploy-bot: Canary route created: route-id rt-7721. Metric alerts: latency_p95>1.8s, error_rate>1.0% (sev2), token_cost_spike>25% (warn).

maria: Great. Final quick checklist: 
- quotas + headroom (tom) ✅
- autoscale hysteresis + canary (adarsh) ✅
- priming & eval (lee) ✅
- preflight call & run-ids (julia/sam) ✅
- PO & billing (maria) ✅
- rollback plan (adarsh) ✅

maria: If no objections we run Fri night. I'll be oncall and reachable on pager. :white_check_mark: :rocket:
